rules.one_tx_one_row: rows that share a tx hash, an actor and a verb fold into one episode (multi-token txs)
rules.fold_window: the same actor doing the same act (same venue / custodian / counterparty) within 60 minutes is one episode; tokens accumulate
rules.price_change: a delist followed by a list of the same token by the same owner within 24 h is ONE price-change episode (the owner's 24 h rule from the journey work); longer is a new listing episode
rules.lock_restructure: lock_merge · lock_split · lock_migrate · lock_permanent · lock_unpermanent in one tx are one lock_restructure episode (housekeeping); lock_add + lock_extend fold as lock_add
rules.new_voter: a lock_create for a wallet with no lock in the ledger before this window is flagged new_voter
rules.under_floor: a listing priced (USD at the time) under its tier's listing floor on that day is flagged under_floor; vs_floor_pct = (usd / floor − 1) × 100; a tier with no floor gets no pct and no flag
rules.days_on_market: a sale carries days_on_market from the seller's last list of that token inside the window; null = listed before the window (unknown, never 0)
rules.thresholds: none here — "big", "over floor" and "mass" percentages are the page's curated config; this file carries facts

note: The last window of the ledger folded into episodes (one act = one row) by lib/activity.js; facts only — thresholds live in tla-core/docs/curated/alert-thresholds.json. Rebuilt every run by org-nft-flows.
